# brig sandbox list

List the sandboxes of a VM, or of every running VM

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox list [VM]
```

Also: `brig sandbox ls`.

## Description

List the sandboxes in every workspace of a VM's gateway, or with --all-vms,
of every running VM's gateway. -w lists only that workspace's; BRIG\_WORKSPACE
does not narrow the list.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox list dev
brig sandbox list --all-vms -o json
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--all-vms` | list the sandboxes of every running VM |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `-w, --workspace string` | list only the sandboxes of this workspace |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
